section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study conducted at a university in Hong Kong. The sample consisted of 457 women and 417 men (total N=874) ranging in age from 16 to 54 years (M=19.97). Participants reported their BMI, which ranged from 14.87 to 32.05 kg/m² (M=20.35).
